responsibilities: Ansel uses actual self-heals and the 3873 boost before Spot's 4083 activation.

survival_dependencies: The narrow second-salvo self-heal budget must hold under actual target selection.

battle_phases.start_condition: Melantha is deployed centrally and late spawns approach.
survival_dependencies: Friston and Fang remain under actual medical support.

survival_dependencies: No hostile was released by earlier retreats or deaths.

Melantha handles the opening and wounds the second officer; Spot inherits it and all later lower-outer traffic.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central blocking, adjacent lower-central damage and conditional DP.
Upper-outer interception, eastern upper roadblock and central crossfire.
Opening lower-outer damage and partial eastern lower roadblock clearance.
Heal Fang, Friston, Hibiscus, Steward and himself.
Lower-outer succession, remaining eastern lower roadblock damage and healing for himself and Ansel.
Heal Midnight, Fang, northern Steward and herself.
Artillery kill and central approach damage under both medics.
Damage lower-central enemies held by Friston.

formation_structure.cost: First deployments of all eight IDs cost 113 DP. Three later redeployments add 43. Scheduled living retreats refund 7+9+5 DP under the current executor.
formation_structure.critical_survival_dependency: Spot's first healing window prevents Ansel's original five-impact collapse. Before Spot's second window, Ansel must survive the renewed southern exposure through actual self-healing; the narrow conditional packet budget is recorded in the selected comparison.
formation_structure.economy_basis: Initial 10 DP, natural recovery, Fang grants at 570/1320/2070 and Melantha's living retreat refund of 7 at 1680. Later Fang grants are unnecessary for this conservative opening ledger. Failure to obtain income or refund is a survival/handoff failure.
formation_structure.medical_limits: Neither ordinary medic covers Spot. Spot does not heal Friston or Midnight. Ansel cannot heal Melantha at [4,4]. No probabilistic healing or dodge is credited.
formation_structure.replacement: Remove Beagle and Lancet; add Spot. Spot inherits lower-outer blocking, supplies timed healing to Ansel and completes Melantha's unfinished eastern lower roadblock.
formation_structure.splash_geometry: Spot and Ansel are sqrt(2) apart, outside a 1.2-radius splash centered on either. Northern Steward is two tiles from Hibiscus and sqrt(10) from Ansel. A Hibiscus-centered impact also threatens adjacent Midnight and Fang.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw living Melantha while her second lower-outer officer remains wounded; receive seven DP.
Spot takes the same tile and inherits the released officer plus unfinished roadblock damage.
Hibiscus supplies direct Midnight healing before later upper-outer officer pressure.
Spot enters healing mode while retaining three-block capacity; Ansel's artillery recovery gains a second healer.
Northern Steward begins artillery damage under both medics.
Spot's second healing window supports the renewed southern artillery exposure.
Melantha returns beside Friston after 2461 frames off field.
Spot heals during the final lower-outer accumulation after the first two later officers should have died.
Steward leaves after artillery death and final approach work.
Steward returns after 2101 frames for western upper clearance.
Release Fang only after upper-central hostile clearance.
Fang returns after 2101 frames for western lower clearance.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the eight listed normal-mode rarity 1-3 IDs; no hidden substitutions or additional deployments.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction; never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Melantha must be alive at 1680. Spot must legally deploy and intercept the released lower officer immediately; retreat refunds seven DP, death refunds none.
Do not assume Spot outranks Ansel: current operator-ID selection puts Ansel before Spot when both qualify. Spot's decisive contribution is healing adjacent Ansel, not universal artillery redirection.
Spot must finish roadblock #4 before the lower civilian becomes an artillery target near it; projected clearance around 110-114 seconds is conditional, not observed.
Ansel must enter renewed southern exposure near full HP and receive sufficient actual self-heals before Spot activates at 4083. The conditional 54.8-HP packet margin is not a survival certificate.
Spot never releases an enemy through a fourth simultaneous occupant. Officers #16 and #18 must be dead before the 6100 healing pause; later arrivals must fit within three blocks.
Friston remains until lower armor and throwers are dead; Melantha returns before their decisive pressure. Fang remains until upper-central clearance.

Only deployed living operators receive skills or retreats. Enforce source costs and actual cooldowns; scheduled returns exceed 70 seconds. Current executor uses unchanged source deployment costs, not an invented client cost schedule.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block neutral civilians; ordinary medics do not heal them. Preserve upstream interception and account for fixed-point artillery projectiles already born.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two safe protected arrivals. Operator deaths are assessed separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Maintain four interception lanes, living Fang income and the Melantha-to-Spot handoff. Midnight must survive until direct Hibiscus coverage begins.
Spot supports Ansel through opening artillery impacts while postponing device attacks during healing. Establish northern Steward and preserve Friston's medical access.
Finish eastern lower roadblock before civilian exposure; heal northern splash victims; bridge Ansel's second southern exposure into Spot's second skill.
Melantha clears lower armor and paired throwers. Keep both central holders below capacity and lower-outer occupancy at three or fewer.
Finish residual armor and Spot's held officers; preserve interception while Steward clears the western upper restraint.
Fang clears the western lower restraint. Continue until both civilians arrive and every hostile has been killed without leaks.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP; only living, deployed grants at 570/1320/2070 fund the opening.
Opening arts, second ready arts window and residual armor clearance.
First-ready boosted healing, renewed southern exposure and late central recovery; no extra-heal talent.
First-ready boost covers northern artillery reception and splash recovery, followed by central support.
Heal self and adjacent Ansel. Each 25-second activation stops attacks and device damage while retaining blocking. Subsequent activations respect 40 seconds of inactive SP recovery.
Accelerate lower armor and early paired-thrower clearance behind Friston.
Ordinary arts and automatic attack-SP strikes; supported high-defense priority favors artillery. No manual targeting.

tactical_thesis: Replace Beagle and Lancet with Spot. Preserve four-lane interception, transfer the wounded lower-outer officer from Melantha to Spot, and use Spot's healing windows to support exposed Ansel. Ansel retains central and northern medical coverage; Hibiscus directly covers Midnight and northern Steward. This is a complete, statically checked candidate, not a verified WIN.
